usageNote: 动词短语，理科课、说明书、演讲超常见！想让别人听懂原理就用它，超实用！

examples.en: The teacher used diagrams to explain how things work in the human body.
examples.zh: 老师用图表来解释人体的运作原理。

examples.en: This book is great for kids because it explains how things work in simple terms.
examples.zh: 这本书很适合孩子，因为它用简单的语言解释了事物的运作方式。
